title: juglans regia f. monophylla
intro: Juglans regia f. monophylla, commonly known as Persian walnut or single-leaf walnut, is a variant of the walnut tree found primarily in Iran and Turkey. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Juglans regia f. monophylla include acting as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic, with potential applications in treating conditions such as high blood pressure and arthritis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include juglone, a lignan with potential anticancer and antimicrobial properties, as well as other phenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal benefits.
